task:
Find the top 5 weekly GAINERS and the top 5 weekly LOSERS among real, liquid US stocks.

Use Finviz, which does the filtering and sorting in the URL so you do not have to operate any controls. Open each of these with interactive=true:

GAINERS:
https://finviz.com/screener.ashx?v=141&f=cap_midover,sh_price_o5&o=-perf1w

LOSERS:
https://finviz.com/screener.ashx?v=141&f=cap_midover,sh_price_o5&o=perf1w

Those URLs already exclude the junk: cap_midover means a market cap above $2B and sh_price_o5 means a share price above $5, so you will get real companies rather than delisted sub-penny shells. v=141 is the Performance view, which carries the 'Perf Week' column. The minus sign in o=-perf1w sorts descending for the gainers; without it, ascending for the losers.

On each page call action.browser_extract_table to read the rows. The page has several tables — the one you want has 'Ticker' and 'Perf Week' in its header. Take the top 5 rows of each.

Give me two tables — GAINERS and LOSERS — each with: ticker, company name, weekly % change, and price.

Report only what you actually read off the page. If a field is not shown, write 'not shown' rather than guessing it.
